feedback: Decision: approve. This candidate is valid and not obviously broken, it is the first test that changes the sensor layout, and we are in early exploration with 9 iterations left. Every race so far has ended off track with one line-loss event. Iteration 1 (kd 0.05 to 0.30) raised progress on s-bend (0.04 to 0.157) and slalom (0.035 to 0.110) and left the oval unchanged (progress 0.115, max_error 0.0607). That result shows kd does not fix the oval, so the oval failure is probably a sensing or recovery problem. Iteration 1 also pushed steering_oscillation to 0.154 on s-bend and 0.158 on slalom, both above the 0.15 threshold. This candidate follows the requested kd reduction to 0.15 and widens the sensor spread from +/-0.04 m to +/-0.05 m with weights unchanged. The wider array is the right lever for the oval, since it is the only track where kd had no effect. The main weakness is attribution: I asked for one field group at a time, and this changes kd and sensor layout together. Read the race as follows. (a) If the oval shows fewer line-loss events or a higher progress than 0.115, the wider array is helping; keep it. (b) If steering_oscillation falls below 0.15 on s-bend and slalom while progress stays near the iteration 1 values, kd 0.15 is the right damping. (c) If the robot still leaves the track with line_loss_events at 1 on every track, the layout change alone is not enough. Revise by changing line_loss to search_left or search_right, keeping this geometry. (d) If steering_oscillation is still above 0.15 with kd 0.15, lower kd to about 0.10 before changing kp. (e) If the robot completes but completion_time is above 2.5 s, raise base_speed in steps of about 0.2.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events stays at 1 on every track, set controller.line_loss to search_right or search_left, keeping the widened sensors. Iteration 0 and 1 show last_direction gave one line-loss event per run on all tracks.
If steering_oscillation stays above 0.15 with kd 0.15 (iteration 1 gave 0.154 and 0.158 at kd 0.30), reduce controller.kd to about 0.10 and keep kp at 4.0.

If the oval shows no change from the iteration 1 baseline (progress 0.115, max_error 0.0607), the wider array is not the fix. Then revert the sensor spread to +/-0.04 m and test a larger sensor_size (0.016) or base_speed 1.4 before changing kp.
